mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, increasing metabolism of carisoprodol and its active metabolite meprobamate, reducing carisoprodol efficacy while additive CNS depression occurs.
action: Monitor for reduced muscle relaxant efficacy; consider alternative agent or increased carisoprodol dosing with careful CNS depression assessment; avoid if possible due to multiple interaction pathways.
